for i in range(5):
    result = action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    blue_positions = []

            rows = [p[0] for p in b]

          f"board_changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')}, "
          f"gameplay_changed={last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}, "
          f"no_impact={last_action_result.get('no_impact')}")
    if not last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed'):
        print("  -> Hit boundary or no impact")
        break
</parameter>
